integrity: Derived from cited primary toric geometry and an explicit integral lattice proof. Finite check examples corroborate but do not prove universal assertions. The public text makes no independent-audit or historical-priority claim.
limitations: Complex ground field, n>=4, algebraic local Weil class groups only; no assertion for completions, global class groups, or higher secants. Uses the established cumulant chart and the published singular-locus description.
title: Integral local divisor-class compatibility on binary Segre secants
